headline: Isak will start
body: The Standard (Jack Tanner), 31 Oct 2026: Andoni Iraola will welcome back seven Liverpool regulars vs Arsenal including Alexander Isak, who is expected to return to the starting lineup at Anfield. Predicted 4-2-3-1 with Isak leading the line: Alisson; Araújo, Jacquet, Van Dijk, Kerkez; Gravenberch, Mac Allister; Barcola, Wirtz, Gakpo; Isak.
